# Regional Comparison

This folder contains topic pages analyzing the geographical variations in healthcare quality and clinical outcomes across Denmark's five regions. It specifically details differences in acute surgery indicators—such as timely antibiotic administration, early mobilization, intermediate admissions, and 30-day mortality rates stratified by Charlson comorbidity scores—to highlight how regional differences in organization, capacity, and clinical practice impact patient care.

## Pages

- [[regional-comparison|Regional Comparison]] — Details the statistical variations across Denmark's five regions for multiple acute surgery clinical indicators and 30-day mortality rates, highlighting disparities in care quality and organizational capacity.
